name: Gorgias
summary: E-commerce customer service with an AI agent for Shopify and more.
description: Gorgias brings online stores' email, chat and social messages together, with order data next to each conversation. Its AI agent answers common requests and can handle returns or order changes.
features: Order data next to each conversation

summary_fr: Service client e-commerce avec agent IA pour Shopify et autres boutiques.
